question: Among the given ores, which one has the highest iron content?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hematite**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hematite has **60-70% metallic content.**
 
• It is **Reddish and of the best quality.**
 
• 80% of Hematite reserves are in **Odisha, Jharkhand, Chattisgarh and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• **Hematite ore is one of the most Important Industrial iron ores** in terms of the Quantity used.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Limonite, a type of **major iron mineral, hydrated ferric oxide (******FeO(OH)·ₙH₂O******)****. It was initially known as **one of a series of such oxides.**
 
• Siderite, also known as **Chalybite,** **iron carbonate (FeCO****₃****)**, **a universal mineral which is an**** ore of iron**.
 
• Pyrite, also known as** iron pyrite,** **a naturally occurring**** iron disulfide mineral**
